writer.name: 茹然瑙·克赖夫 Zsuzsanna Kreif

director.name: 茹然瑙·克赖夫 Zsuzsanna Kreif

introduction: In a country where men seem more interested in their electronic gadgets than their peers, a group of lonely and disillusioned women take the Limbo Limbo bus. Off to a far exotic country, they hope to find the so expected happiness. They land on an island populated by a tribe of mustache-men. This meeting triggers the primitive instincts of these women who, without caring about the civilized behavior rules, start chasing them and pushed by the competitive spirit, are ready to fight the forces of nature in order to capture their prey : the male.
